[BEGIN]
module TopModule (
    input  logic clock,
    input  logic a,
    output logic p,
    output logic q
);

    always_latch begin
        if (clock) p = a;
    end

    always_ff @(negedge clock) begin
        q <= p;
    end

endmodule
[DONE]
